name: Cobb Cubes Comeback 2A 2021
information:
# Registration is closed and the waitlist is now full.

This competition is a **series competition** with [Cobb Cubes Comeback 2B 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CobbCubesComeback2B2021). Please review the Series Competition tab for more information.

This competition is in the **morning**, competitors for this competition should leave at noon and not stay in the venue.

Make sure to dress up and partake in our Costume Contest! Awards for podium placements will be given during the awards ceremony.

Please review the Competitor Information tab before the competition.
Please review the Safety Precautions tab for information regarding steps taken to increase competitor safety at this competition.
Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.
